title: Saharan Dust Lifted Per Year vs. the Great Pyramid

source.name: Yu et al., satellite study of trans-Atlantic Saharan dust transport

notes: NASA's CALIPSO-based study estimated about 182 million tons of dust leave the Sahara each year. The Great Pyramid of Giza's mass is commonly estimated at about 6 million tons, used here only as a size reference. Recalled from NASA's published study summary; not live-refreshed this run because outbound network access was unavailable in this session.
